about.heading: About me
about.body: I’m Arun, a PGP student at IIM Kozhikode who started as an engineer and now works on the question behind the code: what’s worth building, and for whom? I studied CSE at BMSCE, worked as an SE II, and interned at Samsung R&D and Fidelity Investments. At Wipro Consulting, I evaluated ~220 small language models for a single use case and wrote a 0-to-1 BRD. Alongside my studies, I build agentic AI systems and take on case competitions, and I was a National Semi-Finalist at the Tata Imagination Challenge 2025 and at The Ken Case Competition (top 7% among 6,000+ teams). Engineer by training, strategist by habit, and I care about outcomes, not output.

projects.title: Cartis: AI shopping agent
projects.summary: Say what you need once, get three trusted picks. Fewer returns.
projects.details: A buyer-side shopping agent for Indian shoppers: speak once, get three picks with the reasons. Review risk scoring, zero-form onboarding from order emails, and Pine Labs + Delhivery rails.

projects.title: Agentic AI portfolio
projects.summary: AI agents that run repetitive marketing and alumni work, with human sign-off.

projects.title: KampusSchedule
projects.summary: One campus app for timetables, attendance, buses and meals. No sign-up.
projects.details: Syncs from the official timetable sheet, pushes alerts when a class changes, and finds common free time with friends.

decks.title: SLM Evaluation Framework: picking 1 model from ~200
